Copper alloy coin. Dupondius of Hadrian (117-138), mint of Rome, possibly RIC vol. 2 no. 600, issue of 119-121 (cf. Moorhead nd. Page 82, fig. 2). Obverse description: Radiate head right, line of pearl-like curls at brow. Obverse inscription: [--]TRAIANVS HADRIANVS[---].
